title: Vermont Statutes Annotated, Title 21 (Labor), Chapter 5 (Employment Practices), Subchapter 2 - Wages and Medium of Payment
verified_how: fetched https://legislature.vermont.gov/statutes/chapter/21/005 (HTTP 200): headings 'Title 21 : Labor' and 'Chapter 005 : Employment Practices', subchapter heading 'Subchapter 002 : WAGES AND MEDIUM OF PAYMENT' listing s 341 (Definitions), 342 (Weekly payment of wages), 342a (Investigation of complaints of unpaid wages), 343 (Form of payment), 344 (Assignment of future wages), 345 (Nonpayment of wages and benefits), 346, 347 (Forfeiture) and 348 (Retaliation prohibited); the Title 21 index page gives 'Chapter 005 : Employment Practices - Contains: ss 301 - 561'. Every page of the Vermont Statutes Online carries the currency line 'The Statutes below include the actions of the 2025 session of the General Assembly.' and the caveat 'NOTE: The Vermont Statutes Online is an unofficial copy of the Vermont Statutes Annotated that is provided as a convenience.' No repeal marker appears on the cited provisions; repealed sections elsewhere in the same chapters are explicitly flagged 'Repealed. <act cite>', so the absence of that marker is meaningful.
notes: s 342b and s 345a are shown as repealed. s 346 (Enforcement by Attorney General; employee misclassification) is shown as '[Repealed effective July 1, 2026]'; because the site is current only through the 2025 session, that repeal has now taken effect but is not yet reflected in the listing. The minimum wage sits in the adjacent Subchapter 3 (MINIMUM WAGES, ss 381-398).
